papers.title: DeepSight: An All-in-One LM Safety Toolkit

training_data.name: ProGuard-data
training_data.quote: This dataset is multimodal data used to train ProGuard-7B and ProGuard-3B.

training_method.objective_quote: We employ the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) in conjunction with the balanced dataset constructed in Section 4.2 to optimize the model’s policy for the moderation task. ... we bypass the SFT stage entirely and adopt pure GRPO training

source_claims.quote: The training is performed on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone using reinforcement fine-tuning to enhance ProGuard’s reasoning-based safety moderation ability.

description.text:
ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

This model is the official open-source implementation of ProGuard. For deployment instructions, please refer to this link.

output_type.quote: If you determine the request is safe and response is safe: only output Request and Response safety labels.

use_claim.quote: ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

serving.text_only_input_quote: It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities
serving.system_prompt: Check if there is unsafe content in 'User' and 'Agent' messages in a text-only conversation according to our safety policy.
serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The API chat template inserts 'You are a helpful assistant.' when the first message is not a system message. config.json text_config._name_or_path is /mnt/shared-storage-user/yushaohan/ckpt-7b/global_step_160/actor/huggingface. tokenizer model_max_length is 131072. DeepSafe README links this exact repo as its ProGuard evaluation model. Pipeline tag is image-text-to-text. No adapter_config.json in the repo.

evaluation_reported.text: In prompt classification, our ProGuard-7B model sets the state-of-the-art performance among open-source guard models across all modalities, with results comparable to those of closed-source models such as GPT-4o-mini. The paper also reports ProGuard-7B on response classification, unsafe-content categorization, and out-of-distribution category inference.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are empty. The paper trains this backbone with GRPO: learning rate 1e-6, training batch size 512, 1 epoch. proguard-train.sh sets train batch 256 and experiment name safety_grm_qwen3vl_8b_megatron_grpo, so that script is not recorded as this checkpoint's run. Dataset and parent match. The paper names the backbone Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which is the card's parent without the Qwen/ prefix.
